Fulbright Nehru Postdoctoral Research Fellowships 2026-27 is an opportunity offered by the United States-India Education Foundation (USIEF) to Indian faculty and researchers who are in the early stages of their research careers in India. Applications are invited for the following fields only:
Political Science (including, but not limited to, International Security and Strategic Studies)
Urban and Regional Planning (with emphasis on smart cities and waste management)
The selected candidates will receive a monthly stipend and other benefits.
To be eligible, an applicant must:-
hold a Ph.D. degree or a D.M. degree within the past four years (15 July 2021 - 14 July 2025)
have a publication in a reputed journal
demonstrate evidence of superior academic and professional achievement
demonstrate proficiency in the English language
In the application, the applicants are required to indicate the period in which they can complete the proposed project in the United States.
The applicants must determine the grant duration carefully and should be selected for a grant. It will be for the period specified in their application.
The following benefits will be received by the selected fellows:-
Accident and sickness program for exchanges per U.S. Government guidelines

- Subject to availability of funds, a dependent allowance and international travel may be provided for one accompanying eligible dependent, provided the dependent is with the grantee in the U.S. for at least 80 per cent of the grant period.
FNPOSTDOC Letter of Support from the Home Institution, if employed

The selection process involves initial screening of the applications received, followed by national interviews conducted in Delhi. After the interview, the final selection is made by the United States-India Educational Foundation (USIEF).
In the application, the applicant is required to indicate the precise period in which they can complete the proposed project in the United States. This duration cannot be changed.
The applicants are required to upload their Ph.D. or master's degree certificate/provisional Ph.D. certificate on the online application.
Applicants must upload a recent significant publication (copy of paper/article) on the online application (not exceeding 30 pages).

If candidates are employed, they need to obtain the endorsement from the appropriate administrative authority on the Letter of Support from the Home institution. The employer must indicate that leave will be granted for the fellowship period.
Candidates working under government-funded projects are also required to get an endorsement from their affiliating institutions in India.

Candidates must be aware that their ability to visit the United States and take part in academic programmes may be impacted by public health conditions, the availability of consular services and travel, as well as institutional operational status and rules in the country.
Plagiarism in the application will lead to disqualifying the applicant's application.
Extensions and transfer of visa sponsorship are not permitted.

Applicants must secure a letter of invitation from a U.S. host institution to be considered for the fellowship. This letter should specify the duration of the visit and will be included as part of the online application.
Question: Who is offering this opportunity?
The United States-India Education Foundation (USIEF) is offering this opportunity.
Question: Is there any application fee?
This opportunity offers J-1 visa support.
Question: Can applicants avail multiple Fulbright fellowships?
Eligible applicants can avail only one fellowship during a competition cycle.
Question: What is the application mode?
The application is online through the official website.
